notes: Independently verified lexical evidence — not statistical.

CC BY-SA 4.0 ShareAlike applies to this adapted lexical subset.
Greek loanword ≠ proof of reconstructed Greek inflection.
Illustrative NT span ids (when present) are JAK-32 handles from train-split NT gold only — not Thomas fragment Greek, and never decoder-training exemplars (illustrative_spans_are_non_training).
Usable by JAK-39 as hard constraints / stronger L-evidence.
Certification requires TEI field match; spot_check.result=pass alone is insufficient.
